decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost staple in the firm's core thermoforming consumables range, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger for problemistic search.
PETG thermoforming blanks are a mainstream material for dental laboratories that sits squarely in the established business, so keeping them is the satisficing choice.
The UV-curing lacquer has only limited visibility and uncertain results, but it is a cheap complementary consumable that a large firm's slack can easily carry.

Demand for contrast sprays may fall as intraoral scanners become powder-free, which raises the risk of a shortfall, but the product still supports the digital workflow strategy and costs little to keep.
Custom earmolds are core to the firm's skilled custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, and results appear near aspiration, so there is no reason to drop them.
Custom hearing protection shares the earmold production capabilities and serves a growing occupational and leisure market, so the firm continues to carry it.
